field_principles.confidence_baseline_auroc_on_corpus: Must be in (0.5,0.95) so confidence has signal but verifiers have headroom.
field_principles.corpus_path_used: Which corpus downstream rows must score (v3).
field_principles.corpus_source: Dataset, split, evidence field, and URL provenance.
field_principles.evidence_independent_of_label: True only when evidence is paired across both labels.
field_principles.facts_corpus_has_evidence: BARE bool gate for grounding-verifier path.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Fetches + validates a labeled dataset; no live LLM generation in the headline path.
field_principles.n_examples: Sample-size rigor; >=200 for a percentage-point AUROC claim downstream.
field_principles.placeholder_tokens_rejected: Confirms toy R/H/Q placeholder rows are absent.
